title: Capability evolution guidance and complete service/MCP surface catalog

surfaces.currentBehavior: Deterministically assigns every Swift service/Auth file and MCP source module in the configured scope to an initial user or operational capability, records source hashes, declared symbols and lexical coupling/read/write/observation/offline signals, and fails generation/checking when any source is unassigned or artifacts are stale.

acceptance: All 41 Swift service/Auth and 47 MCP source files are assigned
An unassigned or changed in-scope source fails generation/checking until reviewed

surfaces.notes: Capability assignment is source triage, not target port/schema approval.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Discovers repository-backed conversion surfaces, including the isolated Ledger target app/core/tests, separately isolated target composition, migration-core and test-support modules/tests, target MCP TypeScript projections and target contract configuration/resources; applies bounded classification batches; detects disappearance and live source drift; validates evidence requirements, product authority and vertical-slice implementation dossiers; emits coverage/authority/slice audits; and enforces cumulative M0-M5 gates. Initial acknowledgment remains one-time; deliberate re-acknowledgment requires an exact reviewed acknowledgeSourceHash that matches the newly observed hash.

tests: generated product-authority and implementation-slice JSON/Markdown freshness checks
intentional live source-hash drift negative check
acceptance: Discovery and validation complete with zero structural errors or warnings
Every surface resolves through exactly one classification batch to reviewed product or technical authorities
All five canonical target specs appear in the reviewed crosswalk and stale generated authority artifacts fail checking
A target slice cannot reach ready without exact authority requirements, complete contract applicability and derived verification obligations
A target surface cannot advance to implemented or later without exactly one correspondingly advanced slice with required evidence
A source edit made after manifest synchronization fails checking
Incomplete M0 exits nonzero with cumulative blockers

surfaces.notes: The explicit hash workflow prevents agents from silently blessing source drift after a characterized file changes. Product-authority roles prevent current or historical Firebase-era specs from silently becoming redesigned target authority. Slice gates prevent implementation/status claims from outrunning exact requirements, contracts, verification and evidence. Separate composition, migration-control and test-support module roots are discovered without placing any of them into Firebase runtime authority.
